facts.business: Minal Industries Limited is a diamantaire and jewellery & engineering company with global operations across the diamond and jewellery value chain.

auditor.name: M/s R H Modi & Co
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on: (a) non-accrual of interest income on loan to subsidiary Minal Infojewels Limited due to uncertainty of realization; (b) write-off of investment and loan receivable of Rs. 408.99 lakhs in wound-up overseas subsidiary Minal International FZE in previous year; (c) ongoing NCLT proceedings regarding share ownership dispute with no expected financial implication.

key_risks: Accumulated losses of Rs. 2216.82 lakhs as at March 31, 2026 raising material uncertainty related to going concern
Uncertainty in recovery of interest and loan outstanding from subsidiary Minal Infojewels Limited due to its accumulated losses
Ongoing NCLT proceedings regarding ownership dispute of equity shares
Write-off of investment and loan in overseas subsidiary Minal International FZE
facts.related_party_note: Related party transactions at arm's length basis during FY 2025-26: (1) Sale of goods and services to associate Minal Infojewels Limited - Rs. 423.09 lakhs; (2) Investment in M/s. RSBL Jewels Partnership Firm - Rs. 0.25 lakhs. No transactions not at arm's length basis.
